name: Natsumi Shamu
source: A young girl who moved to Amaririsu only a year before [url=/c94273]Kyo[/url], despite it being her birthplace. She, along with Kyo, joins a gaming club run by her friend, Sora. Natsumi is the first vision the player receives.
